SELECT SEQ_PROJ_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PROJECTS ( PROJ_ID, WS_ID, PROJ_NAME, PROJ_DESC, LEADER_ID, PROJ_TYPE, PROJ_SCOPE, PROJ_CATEGORY, PROJ_CATEGORY_DETAIL ) VALUES ( #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{wsId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{projName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{projDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{leaderId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{projType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{projScope, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{projCategory, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{projCategoryDetail, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

INSERT INTO EVENTS ( EVENT_ID, TITLE, START_DT, END_DT, PROJ_ID, ITEM_TYPE, USER_ID, EVENT_COLOR ) VALUES ( SEQ_EVENT_ID.NEXTVAL, #{projName} || ' 시작', TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{projId}, 'PROJ', #{leaderId}, '#3788d8' )
INSERT INTO PROJ_MEMBERS (PROJ_MEMBER_ID, PROJ_ID, USER_ID, PROJ_ROLE) VALUES (SEQ_PROJ_MEMBER_ID.NEXTVAL, #{projId}, #{userId}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT m.USER_ID, u.USER_NAME AS "USER_NAME", u.EMAIL, m.PROJ_ROLE, m.PROJ_POSITION AS "PROJ_POSITION" FROM PROJ_MEMBERS m JOIN USERS u ON m.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE m.PROJ_ID = #{projId}
SELECT PROJ_ID, PROJ_NAME, WS_ID FROM PROJECTS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} ORDER BY PROJ_ID DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'TODO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TODO_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IN_PROGRESS_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DONE_CNT, SUM( CASE WHEN STATUS != 'DONE' AND END_DT IS NOT NULL AND END_DT < SYSDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS DELAYED_CNT FROM EVENTS WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND ITEM_TYPE = 'TASK'

SELECT e.EVENT_ID AS TASK_ID, e.TITLE, e.STATUS, e.USER_ID AS "USER_ID", u.USER_NAME AS "USER_NAME", NVL(e.START_TIME_SLOT, 'NONE') AS START_TIME_SLOT, NVL(e.END_TIME_SLOT, 'NONE') AS END_TIME_SLOT, CASE WHEN e.START_TIME_SLOT = 'TIME' AND e.END_TIME_SLOT = 'TIME' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS USE_TIME, CASE WHEN e.START_TIME_SLOT = 'TIME' THEN TO_CHAR(e.START_DT, 'HH24:MI') ELSE NULL END AS START_TIME, CASE WHEN e.END_TIME_SLOT = 'TIME' THEN TO_CHAR(e.END_DT, 'HH24:MI') ELSE NULL END AS END_TIME, TO_CHAR(e.START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE, TO_CHAR(e.END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE, TO_CHAR(e.ACTUAL_START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ACTUAL_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(e.ACTUAL_DONE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ACTUAL_DONE_DATE, CASE WHEN e.STATUS != 'DONE' AND e.END_DT IS NOT NULL AND e.END_DT < SYSDATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DELAYED_YN FROM EVENTS e LEFT JOIN USERS u ON e.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE e.PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND e.ITEM_TYPE = 'TASK' ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.STATUS != 'DONE' AND e.END_DT IS NOT NULL AND e.END_DT < SYSDATE THEN 0 WHEN e.STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN e.STATUS = 'TODO' THEN 2 WHEN e.STATUS = 'DONE' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, e.END_DT ASC NULLS LAST, CASE NVL(e.END_TIME_SLOT, 'PM') WHEN 'AM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, e.EVENT_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EVENTS ( EVENT_ID, PROJ_ID, WS_ID, USER_ID, TITLE, STATUS, ITEM_TYPE, START_DT, END_DT, ACTUAL_START_DT, ACTUAL_DONE_DT, START_TIME_SLOT, END_TIME_SLOT ) VALUES ( SEQ_EVENT_ID.NEXTVAL, #{projId}, #{wsId}, #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{title}, #{status}, 'TASK', CASE WHEN #{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR TRIM(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || CASE WHEN #{startTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'TIME' AND #{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(#{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' || #{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ':00' WHEN #{startTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'PM' THEN ' 13:00:00' WHEN #{startTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'NONE' THEN ' 00:00:00' ELSE ' 09:00:00' END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) END, CASE WHEN #{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR TRIM(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || CASE WHEN #{endTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'TIME' AND #{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(#{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' || #{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ':59' WHEN #{endTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'AM' THEN ' 12:00:00' WHEN #{endTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'NONE' THEN ' 23:59:59' ELSE ' 18:00:00' END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) END, CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'DONE') THEN SYSDATE ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DONE' THEN SYSDATE ELSE NULL END, NVL(#{startTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'NONE'), NVL(#{endTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'NONE') )
mapper.select: SELECT p.PROJ_ID, p.PROJ_NAME, p.PROJ_DESC, p.LEADER_ID, p.PROJ_TYPE, p.PROJ_SCOPE, p.PROJ_CATEGORY, p.PROJ_CATEGORY_DETAIL, TO_CHAR(e.START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE, TO_CHAR(e.END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE FROM PROJECTS p LEFT JOIN EVENTS e ON p.PROJ_ID = e.PROJ_ID AND e.ITEM_TYPE = 'PROJ' WHERE p.PROJ_ID = #{projId}

SELECT e.EVENT_ID AS "TASK_ID", e.PROJ_ID AS "PROJ_ID", e.TITLE, e.STATUS, e.USER_ID AS "USER_ID", u.USER_NAME AS "USER_NAME", NVL(e.START_TIME_SLOT, 'NONE') AS "START_TIME_SLOT", NVL(e.END_TIME_SLOT, 'NONE') AS "END_TIME_SLOT", CASE WHEN e.START_TIME_SLOT = 'TIME' AND e.END_TIME_SLOT = 'TIME' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "USE_TIME", CASE WHEN e.START_TIME_SLOT = 'TIME' THEN TO_CHAR(e.START_DT, 'HH24:MI') ELSE NULL END AS "START_TIME", CASE WHEN e.END_TIME_SLOT = 'TIME' THEN TO_CHAR(e.END_DT, 'HH24:MI') ELSE NULL END AS "END_TIME", TO_CHAR(e.START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "START_DATE", TO_CHAR(e.END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "END_DATE", TO_CHAR(e.ACTUAL_START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "ACTUAL_START_DATE", TO_CHAR(e.ACTUAL_DONE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "ACTUAL_DONE_DATE", CASE WHEN e.STATUS != 'DONE' AND e.END_DT IS NOT NULL AND e.END_DT < SYSDATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "DELAYED_YN" FROM EVENTS e LEFT JOIN USERS u ON e.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_ID = #{taskId} AND e.ITEM_TYPE = 'TASK'
mapper.update: UPDATE EVENTS SET TITLE = #{title}, USER_ID = NVL(#{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, USER_ID), START_DT = CASE WHEN #{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR TRIM(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || CASE WHEN #{startTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'TIME' AND #{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(#{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' || #{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ':00' WHEN #{startTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'PM' THEN ' 13:00:00' WHEN #{startTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'NONE' THEN ' 00:00:00' ELSE ' 09:00:00' END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) END, END_DT = CASE WHEN #{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR TRIM(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || CASE WHEN #{endTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'TIME' AND #{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(#{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' || #{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ':59' WHEN #{endTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'AM' THEN ' 12:00:00' WHEN #{endTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'NONE' THEN ' 23:59:59' ELSE ' 18:00:00' END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) END, STATUS = #{status}, START_TIME_SLOT = NVL(#{startTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'NONE'), END_TIME_SLOT = NVL(#{endTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'NONE'), ACTUAL_START_DT = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'TODO' THEN NULL WHEN #{status} IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'DONE') AND ACTUAL_START_DT IS NULL THEN SYSDATE ELSE ACTUAL_START_DT END, ACTUAL_DONE_DT = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DONE' AND ACTUAL_DONE_DT IS NULL THEN SYSDATE WHEN #{status} != 'DONE' THEN NULL ELSE ACTUAL_DONE_DT END WHERE EVENT_ID = #{taskId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND ITEM_TYPE = 'TASK'

UPDATE PROJECTS SET PROJ_NAME = #{projName}, PROJ_DESC = #{projDesc}, PROJ_TYPE = #{projCategory}, PROJ_SCOPE = NVL(#{projScope}, PROJ_SCOPE), PROJ_CATEGORY = #{projCategory}, PROJ_CATEGORY_DETAIL = #{projCategoryDetail} WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId}
UPDATE EVENTS SET START_DT = TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), END_DT = TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND ITEM_TYPE = 'PROJ'

UPDATE EVENTS SET STATUS = #{status}, ACTUAL_START_DT = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'TODO' THEN NULL WHEN #{status} IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'DONE') AND ACTUAL_START_DT IS NULL THEN SYSDATE ELSE ACTUAL_START_DT END, ACTUAL_DONE_DT = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DONE' AND ACTUAL_DONE_DT IS NULL THEN SYSDATE WHEN #{status} != 'DONE' THEN NULL ELSE ACTUAL_DONE_DT END WHERE EVENT_ID = #{taskId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND ITEM_TYPE = 'TASK'
mapper.select: SELECT EVENT_ID, PROJ_ID, WS_ID, USER_ID, TITLE, NVL(START_TIME_SLOT, 'NONE') AS START_TIME_SLOT, NVL(END_TIME_SLOT, 'NONE') AS END_TIME_SLOT, CASE WHEN START_TIME_SLOT = 'TIME' AND END_TIME_SLOT = 'TIME' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS USE_TIME, CASE WHEN START_TIME_SLOT = 'TIME' THEN TO_CHAR(START_DT, 'HH24:MI') ELSE NULL END AS START_TIME, CASE WHEN END_TIME_SLOT = 'TIME' THEN TO_CHAR(END_DT, 'HH24:MI') ELSE NULL END AS END_TIME, TO_CHAR(START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE, TO_CHAR(END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE, ITEM_TYPE, STATUS, COLOR FROM EVENTS WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND ITEM_TYPE = 'SCHEDULE' ORDER BY START_DT ASC, EVENT_ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EVENTS ( EVENT_ID, PROJ_ID, WS_ID, USER_ID, TITLE, STATUS, ITEM_TYPE, START_DT, END_DT, START_TIME_SLOT, END_TIME_SLOT, COLOR ) VALUES ( SEQ_EVENT_ID.NEXTVAL, #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{wsId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'SCHEDULE', CASE WHEN #{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR TRIM(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || CASE WHEN #{startTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'TIME' AND #{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(#{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' || #{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ':00' ELSE ' 00:00:00' END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) END, CASE WHEN #{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR TRIM(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || CASE WHEN #{endTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'TIME' AND #{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(#{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' || #{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ':59' ELSE ' 23:59:59' END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) END, NVL(#{startTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'NONE'), NVL(#{endTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'NONE'), #{color, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT EVENT_ID AS "SCHEDULE_ID", EVENT_ID, PROJ_ID, WS_ID, USER_ID, TITLE, NVL(START_TIME_SLOT, 'NONE') AS "START_TIME_SLOT", NVL(END_TIME_SLOT, 'NONE') AS "END_TIME_SLOT", CASE WHEN START_TIME_SLOT = 'TIME' AND END_TIME_SLOT = 'TIME' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "USE_TIME", CASE WHEN START_TIME_SLOT = 'TIME' THEN TO_CHAR(START_DT, 'HH24:MI') ELSE NULL END AS "START_TIME", CASE WHEN END_TIME_SLOT = 'TIME' THEN TO_CHAR(END_DT, 'HH24:MI') ELSE NULL END AS "END_TIME", TO_CHAR(START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "START_DATE", TO_CHAR(END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "END_DATE", ITEM_TYPE, STATUS, COLOR FROM EVENTS WHERE EVENT_ID = #{scheduleId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND ITEM_TYPE = 'SCHEDULE'
mapper.update: UPDATE EVENTS SET TITLE = #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, START_DT = CASE WHEN #{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR TRIM(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || CASE WHEN #{startTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'TIME' AND #{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(#{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' || #{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ':00' ELSE ' 00:00:00' END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) END, END_DT = CASE WHEN #{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR TRIM(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || CASE WHEN #{endTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'TIME' AND #{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(#{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' || #{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ':59' ELSE ' 23:59:59' END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) END, START_TIME_SLOT = NVL(#{startTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'NONE'), END_TIME_SLOT = NVL(#{endTimeSlot, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'NONE'), STATUS = #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COLOR = #{color, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE EVENT_ID = #{scheduleId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND ITEM_TYPE = 'SCHEDULE'
